ModMetaData.name: VMF Colonist Bar Context Filter v1.1 (RW 1.6)
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: Small, UI-only compatibility patch for Vehicle Map Framework v1.6.673 and Colonist Bar Adjuster. Hides colony-spawned vehicle interior map groups directly in RimWorld's ColonistBar map enumeration; preserves actual world caravan groups. Keeps map groups for vehicle caravans on the world map. Does not modify colonists, saves, car destinations, or pathfinding.
